questions.q: How many REST controllers/endpoints ship in the RC, and under what base path?
questions.a: 91 @RestController classes, 342 method-level endpoints (342 @Get/@Post/@Put/@Delete/@PatchMapping lines, 0 method-level @RequestMapping); all under server.servlet.context-path /api/v1 (application.yml:119). GlobalExceptionHandler is @RestControllerAdvice, not counted.

questions.q: Does every backend endpoint have a real caller (FE, AI service, provider webhook, email link)?
questions.a: No. 13 endpoints have no caller anywhere in the RC: POST /admin/auth/mfa/reset/{id}, POST /admin/brands/{id}/reanalyze, PUT /admin/creator-agent/creators/{id}/monthly-cap, POST /admin/emails/custom/{id}/cancel, DELETE /admin/external-creators/{id}, POST /admin/festival-enquiries/{id}/link-existing, GET /admin/festival-enquiries/{id}/existing-account, POST /admin/platform-stats/backfill, POST /contracts/{id}/cancel, POST /contracts/{id}/amend, POST /wallet/escrow/refund, POST /wallet/escrow/payout, GET /wallet/balance; plus the whole user SupportController (4 endpoints) whose only literal matches are admin-relative paths in src/admin/services/api-contracts.ts.

questions.q: Can a user raise a support ticket from the UI?
questions.a: No. SupportController.java:47-69 exists but no non-admin FE file references /support/tickets; the public /support route renders a StaticPage saying support resources are being set up (App.tsx:861-869). The admin support desk (FE /admin/support) therefore only sees tickets created via API/Meera, if any.

questions.q: Which endpoints are reachable without a JWT?
questions.a: SecurityConfig.java:83-280 permits /health, POST /auth/**, GET /config/public, GET /workspaces/slug-check, POST /webhooks/{razorpay,shopify,woocommerce,conversion,redemption,meta/deauthorize,meta/data-deletion}, GET /.well-known/jwks.json, GET /notifications/unsubscribe-link, GET /track/click/**, GET /portfolio/*, POST /portfolio/*/contact, GET /public/creators/*/verified, POST /client-errors, POST /festival-enquiries(+send-otp), POST /festival/coupon-copied, POST /admin/auth/login|refresh. /admin/** requires ROLE_ADMIN, /creator/** ROLE_CREATOR, everything else authenticated. GET /auth/verify-email is permitted but no such endpoint exists (dead matcher, SecurityConfig.java:93).

questions.q: Are brand-only endpoints (/creators/**, /campaigns/**, /deals/**, /wallet/**) role-gated at the filter level?
questions.a: Not at the filter chain: only /admin/** and /creator/** have role matchers; brand endpoints fall under anyRequest().authenticated() (SecurityConfig.java ~272-280). Any role enforcement for brand routes must come from service-layer checks (e.g. BrandContextService.requireBrandWorkspace as in MeeraInteractionController.java:52). Not verified per endpoint in this inventory pass.

questions.q: How many scheduled jobs run, and are they safe on multiple instances?
questions.a: 24 @Scheduled methods in 23 classes (22 in job/ + CampaignServiceInvoiceService + EmailWorker); every one carries @SchedulerLock (per-file counts equal), ShedLock JDBC provider in config/SchedulerLockConfig.java:33, table from V68__shedlock.sql; @EnableScheduling in config/TaskSchedulerConfig.java. TrendPullJob, CreatorConnectNudgeJob and copilot jobs are flag-gated default false (application.yml:322,542,570).

questions.q: How many FE routes exist and where?
questions.a: 114 route declarations: 92 path= entries in src/App.tsx (incl. 4 Navigate redirects, /admin/* splat, * NotFound, dev-only /dev/motion-skills) + 18 nested in src/pages/admin-console.tsx:69-87 + 4 nested in src/admin/pages/UsersPage.tsx:745-748. src/app contains only globals.css (no Next.js routes).

questions.q: Which AI workflows exist and how are they wired?
questions.a: influora-ai FastAPI: 10 routes (main.py:137,191; routes/*.py). Spring->AI clients: AnalyzeSiteAiClient(/analyze-site), BrandSafetyAiClient(/internal/brand-safety), CreatorSuggestionAiClient(/internal/creator-suggestion), MeeraVoiceAiClient(/voice/speak|transcribe), TrendSparkAiClient(/internal/trendspark/nudge). AI->Spring: 11 /internal/meera/* tool/context endpoints (clients/spring.py, tools/schemas.py). Browser->AI: /chat stream (MEERA_PUBLIC_CHAT_URL). n8n: trend-pull-workflow.json calls /internal/trendspark/tag and writes MySQL directly.

questions.q: Would a broken optional AI router be caught by readiness?
questions.a: No. main.py:79-106 swallows import failures for trendspark, brand_safety, trend_tag, creator_suggestion routers (logger.exception only); /readyz (main.py:191-220) checks keys + Redis only, so ready=200 while /internal/brand-safety etc. return 404.

Partially. n8n workflow has a node literally named "Google Trends (pytrends/SerpAPI - STUB)" of type code; Java TrendPullJob is disabled by default (TREND_INGEST_ENABLED:false, application.yml:570). No runtime evidence either path runs in prod.

questions.q: How much of the controller layer has a direct test?
questions.a: 45 of 91 controllers are referenced by name in at least one of 358 test files; 46 have none (all 22 Admin* controllers except AdminCreatorAgent/AuditLog/AdminBilling-by-service, plus CampaignController, CreatorController, PortfolioController, SupportController, TrendSparkController, UserController, DashboardController, BrandReviewController, CreatorReviewController, CreatorCopilotController, ...). Tests were NOT executed in this pass.

Yes for single-segment paths: App.tsx:882 routes any unmatched /<x> to CreatorPortfolioPublicPage, which renders its own "Page not found" after the API lookup fails (creator-portfolio-public.tsx:208,278); only multi-segment paths reach NotFoundPage (App.tsx:883). This costs one API call per mistyped URL and returns HTTP 200 for SPA 404s.

questions.q: Are all features in this inventory from committed code?
questions.a: Yes: every citation is from the clean RC checkout at commit 115f698 (git status showed 0 changes). Provenance COMMITTED for all items. No runtime/test execution was performed, so no feature is marked VERIFIED WORKING.

findings.title: User support-ticket API has no UI; /support is a placeholder
Backend endpoints with no caller in the RC (dead or API-only surface)
Optional AI routers fail silently and /readyz still reports ready
Brand endpoints have no role gate at the filter chain (authenticated only); creator tokens reach /campaigns, /wallet, /creators unless each service checks
findings.note: Needs per-service authz verification by the security lane; not a confirmed defect.

findings.title: Google Trends source in n8n trend pull is a stub
46/91 controllers have no test referencing them
Single-segment unknown URLs render the portfolio page (API call + HTTP 200) instead of NotFound

method: Python regex over influora-api/src/main/java for ^@RestController classes and @Get/Post/Put/Delete/PatchMapping (cross-checked: 342 mapping lines == 342 endpoints; 85 class-level @RequestMapping); FE callers found by literal/template-string extraction from src/**/*.ts(x) excluding tests (admin paths prefixed /admin, meera-api basePath expanded), then manual grep of every no-caller endpoint.
readiness_note: No tests or runtime were executed; every feature is at most IMPLEMENTED BUT NOT VERIFIED. All provenance COMMITTED.
